- **Gamma-undecalactone**: 
  - Formula: $\text{C}_{11}\text{H}_{20}\text{O}_2$
  - Molecular weight: **184.28 Da** (184.279 Da)

- **Diethyl isobutylmalonate**: 
  - Formula: $\text{C}_{11}\text{H}_{20}\text{O}_4$
  - Molecular weight: **216.28 Da** (216.277 Da)

Diethyl isobutylmalonate is heavier than Gamma-undecalactone by approximately 32 Da (due to having two additional oxygen atoms).
